notes: V5.2.98 — The update screen now plays the same red Opti Gods spinning splash you see when the app opens. V5.2.97 — Fixed the NVIDIA preset showing as missing when it is applied. The FPS counter now starts instantly without asking to download again, stays on next time you open Opti Gods, and retries by itself if it fails to start. Added play, pause and skip buttons for your music. Added Discord voice call detection with your profile picture, and Discord gets extra priority during calls. Added cover art for the Microsoft Store SoundCloud app. Fixed closed apps like Brave staying in the Gaming Mode list. Gaming Mode's background service now updates itself with the app. V5.2.94 — Download and install updates in one click: the installer downloads, is checked against the release, opens by itself and plays the success chime. Signed releases can update and reopen Opti Gods automatically. The update popup shows the real notes for the new version. Gaming Mode shows FiveM by name with your server or main menu, browser tab counts and what is being optimized. The NVIDIA preset no longer shows as missing just because NVIDIA could not be read at startup. V5.2.91 — Fixed live game detection and the FPS counter (Windows telemetry no longer fails with "filename too long"). Now Playing with cover art, and instant music play/pause detection for Gaming Mode. Gaming Mode can now adjust Brave/Chrome tab processes and lists every background app it found. V5.2.90 — Live monitor keeps FPS, temperatures and CPU/GPU/RAM load updating every second while you are in the game, and follows FiveM when it restarts its game process. Red Opti Gods text on the startup splash. V5.2.89 — Gaming Mode now detects Spotify, SoundCloud and browser music while you game: playing audio stays at full speed, other background apps get efficiency mode and low memory priority. Tweak success now always shows the green popup, chime and restart reminder. Admin Gaming Mode test switch in the Performance Recorder (keeps the running game at High priority and lowers background apps, stays on after closing Opti Gods). Recordings save to Downloads automatically. CPU sensor button no longer fails when the driver is already installed. Performance Recorder works with any game: detects games from the built-in library, any game installed in Steam/Epic/Riot/EA/Ubisoft/GOG/Xbox folders, or the app using the GPU, and shows the right cover or the game's own icon (fixes the missing Fortnite logo). Fixes the FPS tile showing "No frames" (PresentMon frame column was not read) and adds clear feedback when the FPS counter downloads and starts. FiveM server box no longer shows "mumble" from voice chat; known servers are named automatically and a pencil lets you set your own name. Tweak audit now reads every registry value each tweak sets and shows applied or missing with the current and needed value, includes the detected game's own tweaks, and can copy missing values as a .reg file. Nothing is written by the audit.
